name: A Weeb Of Lies
source:
Jason is like many of us.

He's a dorky university student from a small town. He enjoys staying inside, watching anime, reading comics and playing video games with his one remaining friend. Nerdy stuff.

Continuing on this path, however, will lead to a fate most unfortunate; for as the prophecy has foretold, whoever shall remain a virgin by the age of thirty is destined to become a wizard. And, sooner or later that wizard will decide the cast the ultimate spell, undoing the very fabric of reality and bringing the most horrific creatures unreality has ever known to the surface! Or, at least, that's what he tells himself.

However, in his quest to get a girlfriend, he must overcome one of the greatest challenges known to man... That is, being social!

Though, as Jason learns to come out of his shell, he might come to realise that he might just be looking for something other than a girlfriend...

[from [url=https://promise-mai.itch.io/a-weeb-of-lies]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
杰森和我们很多人一样。

他是一个来自小镇的傻大学生。他喜欢呆在家里，看动画、看漫画，和他仅存的一位朋友玩电子游戏。书呆子的东西。

然而，继续沿着这条路走下去，将会导致最不幸的命运。因为正如预言所预言的那样，任何人在三十岁之前仍保持处女之身的人注定会成为一名巫师。而且，巫师迟早会决定施放终极咒语，破坏现实的结构，让不现实中最可怕的生物浮出水面！或者，至少，他是这么告​​诉自己的。

然而，在寻找女朋友的过程中，他必须克服人类已知的最大挑战之一……那就是社交！

不过，当杰森学会摆脱自己的外壳时，他可能会意识到自己可能只是在寻找女朋友以外的东西……
